applicabilityBasis.summary: CADC is a Canadian-dollar stablecoin redeemable 1:1 for CAD and marketed for business settlement and payments, so it is an apparent payment stablecoin for GENIUS-scope review.

genius.licensingRegulator: FINTRAC (AML/ATF supervisor); MSB registration C10001420 is held by Loon Payments Inc., an entity distinct from the stored issuerEntity Loon Technology Inc.
genius.notes: FINTRAC MSB registration and Canadian compliance statements are not U.S. GENIUS authorization. No public GENIUS approval, state qualification, OCC foreign registration, official application, or Treasury comparability determination for Loon Technology Inc./CADC was located. Loon's public materials are Canada-focused while also describing settlement in Canada and abroad; the foreign-exception posture remains unknown while rulemaking is proposed.
